commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3d3a38885fb458d7693eab39450dad8506d504f6
BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
GW_SERIAL='40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'
EMU_SERIAL='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
ZB_OFFSET=0x16e000
ZB_SIZE=0x8000

git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

grep -q 'item->attr_type == EZB_ZCL_ATTR_TYPE_ENUM16' main/zigbee_gateway.c
grep -q '#define ZCL_IAS_ZONE_TYPE_CONTACT_SWITCH 0x0015U' main/zigbee_gateway.c
grep -q 'zone_type == ZCL_IAS_ZONE_TYPE_CONTACT_SWITCH' main/zigbee_gateway.c
grep -q '"contact_open"' main/gateway_transport.c

. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null

resolve_port() {
  python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import sys,time
from serial.tools import list_ports
sn=sys.argv[1]
end=time.time()+15
while time.time()<end:
    m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==sn and p.vid==0x303A]
    if len(m)==1:
        print(m[0].device)
        raise SystemExit(0)
    time.sleep(.2)
raise SystemExit(f'identity mismatch for {sn}: {[(p.device,p.serial_number,p.vid) for p in list_ports.comports()]}')
PY
}

GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL")
EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL")
test "$GW_PORT" != "$EMU_PORT"
echo PREBUILD_GW_PORT=$GW_PORT SERIAL=$GW_SERIAL
echo PREBUILD_EMU_PORT=$EMU_PORT SERIAL=$EMU_SERIAL
for P in "$GW_PORT" "$EMU_PORT"; do
  if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1 && lsof "$P" >/tmp/c6_e2e_v5_holders 2>/dev/null; then
    echo PORT_BUSY=$P
    cat /tmp/c6_e2e_v5_holders
    exit 42
  fi
done

idf.py build >/dev/null
echo GW_BUILD_OK
GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL")
echo GW_FLASH_PORT=$GW_PORT SERIAL=$GW_SERIAL
idf.py -p "$GW_PORT" flash >/dev/null
echo GW_FLASH_OK

cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator
rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old
rm -rf build
idf.py set-target esp32c6 >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('sdkconfig')
s=p.read_text()
old='CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED=y'
new='# CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED is not set\nCONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_IAS_CONTACT=y'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('mixed profile default not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
idf.py build >/dev/null
echo EMU_BUILD_OK
cd ../..
EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL")
echo EMU_FLASH_PORT=$EMU_PORT SERIAL=$EMU_SERIAL
cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator
idf.py -p "$EMU_PORT" flash >/dev/null
cd ../..
echo EMU_FLASH_OK
git checkout -- tests/zigbee_device_emulator/dependencies.lock 2>/dev/null || true

GW_PORT=$(resolve_port "$GW_SERIAL")
echo GW_ERASE_PORT=$GW_PORT SERIAL=$GW_SERIAL
python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$GW_PORT" --before default_reset --after no_reset erase_region "$ZB_OFFSET" "$ZB_SIZE" >/dev/null
EMU_PORT=$(resolve_port "$EMU_SERIAL")
echo EMU_ERASE_PORT=$EMU_PORT SERIAL=$EMU_SERIAL
python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$EMU_PORT" --before default_reset --after no_reset erase_region "$ZB_OFFSET" "$ZB_SIZE" >/dev/null
echo FRESH_NETWORK_ZB_STORAGE_ERASED_BOTH

python - <<'PY'
import subprocess, threading, time, serial
from serial.tools import list_ports

GW_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'
EMU_SN='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'

def resolve(sn):
    end=time.time()+15
    while time.time()<end:
        m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==sn and p.vid==0x303A]
        if len(m)==1:
            return m[0].device
        time.sleep(.15)
    raise RuntimeError(f'cannot resolve serial {sn}')

def reset(sn,label):
    p=resolve(sn)
    print(f'{label}_RESET_PORT={p} SERIAL={sn}',flush=True)
    subprocess.run(
        ['python','-m','esptool','--chip','esp32c6','-p',p,
         '--before','default_reset','--after','hard_reset','chip_id'],
        check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return resolve(sn)

logs={'GW':[],'EMU':[]}
stop=threading.Event()

def reader(name,port):
    with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=.1) as s:
        while not stop.is_set():
            b=s.readline()
            if b:
                t=b.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip('\r\n')
                logs[name].append(t)
                print(f'{name}: {t}',flush=True)

gw=reset(GW_SN,'GW_FRESH')
tg=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('GW',gw),daemon=True)
tg.start()

formed_deadline=time.time()+25
while time.time()<formed_deadline:
    if any('network formed' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW']):
        break
    time.sleep(.2)
else:
    stop.set()
    tg.join(timeout=1)
    raise SystemExit('gateway did not form fresh network')

emu=reset(EMU_SN,'EMU_FRESH')
te=threading.Thread(target=reader,args=('EMU',emu),daemon=True)
te.start()

deadline=time.time()+120
while time.time()<deadline:
    has_cap=any('input available zigbee/' in x.lower() and 'read=0x00004000' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
    has_false=any('contact_open=0.000 bool' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
    has_true=any('contact_open=1.000 bool' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
    has_descriptor=any('descriptor' in x.lower() and '0500' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
    if has_cap and has_false and has_true and has_descriptor:
        time.sleep(2)
        break
    time.sleep(.2)

stop.set()
tg.join(timeout=1)
te.join(timeout=1)

g='\n'.join(logs['GW'])
e='\n'.join(logs['EMU'])
gl=g.lower()
el=e.lower()
panic_terms=['abort() was called','guru meditation',"panic'ed",'task watchdog got triggered','assert failed']
gw_panic=[x for x in panic_terms if x in gl]
emu_panic=[x for x in panic_terms if x in el]

has_descriptor=any('descriptor' in x.lower() and '0500' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
has_auth='ZIGBEE_DEVICE_AUTHORIZED' in g
has_basic=('manufacturer=C6Lab' in g and 'model=C6EmuV20' in g)
has_cap=any('input available zigbee/' in x.lower() and 'read=0x00004000' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
has_false=any('contact_open=0.000 bool' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
has_true=any('contact_open=1.000 bool' in x.lower() for x in logs['GW'])
read_failed='ias zonetype read failed' in gl
emu_zt='ias contact initialized zonetype=0x0015 zonestatus=0x0000' in el

print('EVIDENCE_NETWORK_FORMED='+str('network formed' in gl))
print('EVIDENCE_AUTHORIZED='+str(has_auth))
print('EVIDENCE_IAS_DESCRIPTOR_0x0500='+str(has_descriptor))
print('EVIDENCE_BASIC_METADATA='+str(has_basic))
print('EVIDENCE_EMULATOR_LOCAL_ZONETYPE_0x0015='+str(emu_zt))
print('EVIDENCE_IAS_ZONETYPE_READ_FAILED='+str(read_failed))
print('EVIDENCE_CONTACT_CAPABILITY_FROM_REMOTE_ZONETYPE_0x0015='+str(has_cap))
print('EVIDENCE_REMOTE_ZONETYPE_0x0015='+str(has_cap and not read_failed))
print('EVIDENCE_CONTACT_OPEN_FALSE='+str(has_false))
print('EVIDENCE_CONTACT_OPEN_TRUE='+str(has_true))
print('EVIDENCE_GW_PANIC='+str(gw_panic))
print('EVIDENCE_EMU_PANIC='+str(emu_panic))
print('REMOTE_ZONETYPE_PROOF=CONTACT_OPEN capability is set only after successful remote ZoneType ENUM16 read equals 0x0015')

print('=== GW IAS EVIDENCE ===')
for x in logs['GW']:
    l=x.lower()
    if any(k in l for k in ['network formed','authorized','descriptor','manufacturer=c6lab',
                             'model=c6emuv20','input available zigbee/','contact_open',
                             'ias zonetype','panic','abort','guru']):
        print(x)

print('=== EMU IAS EVIDENCE ===')
for x in logs['EMU']:
    l=x.lower()
    if any(k in l for k in ['ias contact initialized','factory_new','network steering',
                             'report request ep=1 cluster=0x0500','panic','abort','guru']):
        print(x)

required=[
    ('network formed','network formed' in gl),
    ('authorized',has_auth),
    ('IAS descriptor 0x0500',has_descriptor),
    ('Basic metadata',has_basic),
    ('emulator ZoneType 0x0015',emu_zt),
    ('remote ZoneType 0x0015',has_cap and not read_failed),
    ('CONTACT_OPEN false',has_false),
    ('CONTACT_OPEN true',has_true),
    ('gateway no panic',not gw_panic),
    ('emulator no panic',not emu_panic),
]
failed=[name for name,ok in required if not ok]
if failed:
    raise SystemExit('E2E FAILED: '+', '.join(failed))
print('FRESH_NETWORK_DUAL_C6_IAS_E2E=PASS')
PY
